fields.label: Brand Name
fields.description: Shown under the animation on the login page. Leave empty to use the product default.

fields.label: Brand Tagline
fields.description: Short optional text under the brand name.

fields.label: Brand Logo
fields.description: Upload a public PNG, JPEG, SVG, GIF or WebP. The logo also appears on the login form.

fields.label: Animation File
fields.description: Upload a public animated GIF/WebP/SVG or a short MP4/WebM video. Video runs muted, looping and inline. Leave empty for the built-in moving-orbit animation.
